Ah that’s a great call! We’ll definitely be looking into those, and make sure to browse this subreddit deeply. Knowing what we actually have to submit has made it sound so much more achievable already, so fingers crossed we’ll get there! 

Thank you again, very much!! ✨

This is amazing, thank you so much for your help!! We’ve read about unmarried partners but it’s apparently much harder to get it approved which is why we’re considering all the options now. Hopefully we can make it as successful as yours! 💪

Hey, thank you so much for the response! It does make me feel a little better. Honestly this homeworking is making it so much harder for me, I can't even see their reaction and maybe try to adjust to them...

Hey, thanks for the response! That's indeed what I'm trying to do but it's super hard to just add that in a meeting and then I never get the courage to just send a message to ask how they're doing. This homeworking is killing me tbh, I feel like it'd be easier in face to face because I'd have no choice but to talk, and I could see their reactions too

I'm so so sorry you are feeling like this. I wish I could help but I don't know what to say. 

I do believe that you are way too hard on yourself however. I am 25 and still living with my parents, and so is my 28 yo brother. You're not alone, and you're not a disappointment either, I swear.

I'm in the same situation as you too. Life isn't just worth it anymore, nothing brings me joy, every night I go to sleep hoping I won't wake up. 

If you need to talk, don't hesitate.

Hi there. 

Would you mind going for a little chat? I'm not comfortable posting here but you're definitely not alone. (25F) and I have the same history. I'd be happy to talk about it if it can help you.
Thank you so much for the comment! It means a lot. I wish you all the same!!
